source_corpus.provenance: User-supplied sample archive; independent parser oracle and family contracts are stored alongside the corpus.
source_corpus.evidence: 678 records from dt.zip plus 50 standalone user-supplied lines (all files inventoried and preserved in the source fixtures).

matching_tiers.name: reviewed-family-parserpack
matching_tiers.purpose: Exact user-supplied Alloy/Vector behavior migrated into reviewed ParserPacks; native family profiles run before broad fallbacks.

matching_tiers.name: known-key-delimiter-extraction
matching_tiers.purpose: Extract only configured source keys with configured assignment and pair separators, quote/escape handling, duplicate policy, and aliases.

matching_tiers.name: static-and-regex-templates
matching_tiers.purpose: Use named static positional layouts and bounded RE2 patterns when exact family profiles do not match.

matching_tiers.name: semantic-entity-and-mime-header-enrichment
matching_tiers.purpose: Explicitly extract IPs/domains/URLs/emails and decode bounded RFC 2047 MIME headers after deterministic parser stages.

matching_tiers.name: drain-template-and-generic-fallback
matching_tiers.purpose: Use masked Drain template candidates and generic structured formats; preserve unclassified lines for safe unknown/quarantine handling; never claim complete semantic parsing.

regex_assets.name: Native mail event prefix
regex_assets.source: Reviewed family ParserPack static layout token

known_key_asset.name: Known key mappings from user sample inventory
known_key_asset.future_keys: Add keys through the Known Keys tab/API with explicit family, separators, alias, and duplicate policy; no code rebuild required.

lossless_contract.required_invariant: For every source field accepted in lossless mode, output field count equals raw source field count. Derived fields require allow_derived; explicit projections require projection count policy.

accuracy_statement: The checked-in sample fixtures have explicit expected outputs and regression tests. Unknown and unstructured logs cannot be guaranteed to parse semantically at 100%; unsupported or ambiguous cases must be reported or quarantined.

semantic_extraction.name: Bounded network and email entity enrichment

mime.charsets: Go MIME decoder supported common charsets

semantic_extraction.encryption: Detect markers only; decrypt only via explicit supported customer-key integration, not arbitrary ciphertext
